name: GuardAgent
description:
Vartija-agentti (Guard Agent).
    Responsible for:
    1. Input Sanitization (Syötteen puhdistus)
    2. Security Check (Tietoturvatarkistus)
    3. Anonymization (Anonymisointi)

name: AnalystAgent
description:
Analyytikko-agentti (Analyst Agent).
    Responsible for:
    1. Evidence Anchoring (Todistepohjainen Ankkurointi)
    2. Creating an 'Evidence Map' (Todistuskartta)

name: InteractionAnalystAgent
description:
InteractionAnalystAgent (Vuorovaikutusanalysaattori).
    
    Analyses the 'history_text' to evaluate Prompt Engineering competence.
    Hybrid logic:
    - AI: Qualitative analysis (Strategies, Driver Classification).
    - Python: Quantitative analysis (Input Control Ratio).

name: ProfilerAgent
description:
Profiloija (Psychologist) Agent.
    Step 2.5: Analyzes the 'human' side of the input: intent, biases, tone.

name: LogicianAgent
description:
Loogikko-agentti (Logician Agent).
    Responsible for:
    1. Argument Construction (Argumentaation Rakentaminen)
    2. Applying Cognitive Assessment Matrix (Bloom/Toulmin)

name: FactualOverseerAgent
description: Faktuaalinen ja Eettinen Valvoja-agentti (Factual & Ethical Overseer).

name: ArchivistAgent
description:
Arkistonhoitaja (Archivist) Agent.
    Step 8.5: Retrieves past cases to ensure consistency (Stare Decisis).

name: PanelAgent
description:
Paneeli-agentti (Panel Agent).
    Executes multiple critical roles in a single LLM call to save tokens and time.
